title: Downregulation of ferroptosis-related ATF3 alleviates lupus nephritis progression.
authors: Xiao, Gong; Tang, Shumei; Zhang, Yan; Yuan, Qiongjing; Sun, Danni; Wang, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学与实验验证研究狼疮肾炎中铁死亡相关基因ATF3的表达及免疫浸润，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The role of ferroptosis in lupus nephritis (LN) is unclear. This study aimed to explore the effects of ferroptosis-related genes in LN through bioinformatics prediction and experimental validation. METHODS: Sample data were collected from the GEO dataset and divided into glomeruli and tubulointerstitium. We collected 382 ferroptosis-related genes. The intersection of ferroptosis-related genes with glomeruli and tubulointerstitium data, respectively, was performed. Machine learning methods (including unsupervised cluster typing and random forests) were operated to identify ferroptosis subtyping and ferroptosis important genes in LN. Immune infiltration and functional analysis were performed. The expression of ferroptosis important gene ATF3 was validated in vivo and in vitro. RESULTS: 6 ferroptosis important genes common to glomeruli and tubulointerstitium were screened, including ATF3, CD44, CYBB, JUN, NCF2, and NNMT. ATF3 decreased in the LN group compared to the Control. Silencing ATF3 mitigated LPS/erastin-induced ferroptosis. Functional analysis showed that ATF3 was markedly enriched in the interferon-gamma-mediated signaling pathway, ECM-receptor interaction, and cell adhesion. In glomeruli, T cells regulatory (Tregs) infiltration decreased and Macrophages M1 levels increased with elevated ATF3 expression. Levels of immune cell infiltration were altered in different ferroptosis subtypes of LN glomeruli and tubulointerstitium. CONCLUSIONS: Ferroptosis-related ATF3 levels decreased in LN. Inhibition of ATF3 might alleviate LN development by affecting the macrophage M1 and Treg cell infiltration. These implied that ATF3 might be a potential target for developing LN therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：铁死亡（ferroptosis）在狼疮性肾炎（LN）中的作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在通过生物信息学预测和实验验证，探讨铁死亡相关基因在LN中的影响。方法：从GEO数据集收集样本数据，并将其分为肾小球和肾小管间质。我们收集了382个铁死亡相关基因。分别将铁死亡相关基因与肾小球和肾小管间质数据进行交集分析。采用机器学习方法（包括无监督聚类分型和随机森林）识别LN中的铁死亡亚型和铁死亡重要基因。进行了免疫浸润和功能分析。在体内和体外验证了铁死亡重要基因ATF3的表达。结果：筛选出肾小球和肾小管间质共有的6个铁死亡重要基因，包括ATF3、CD44、CYBB、JUN、NCF2和NNMT。与对照组相比，LN组中ATF3表达降低。沉默ATF3减轻了LPS/erastin诱导的铁死亡。功能分析显示，ATF3显著富集于干扰素-γ介导的信号通路、ECM-受体相互作用和细胞黏附。在肾小球中，随着ATF3表达升高，调节性T细胞（Tregs）浸润减少，巨噬细胞M1水平增加。在LN肾小球和肾小管间质的不同铁死亡亚型中，免疫细胞浸润水平发生改变。结论：LN中铁死亡相关ATF3水平降低。抑制ATF3可能通过影响巨噬细胞M1和Treg细胞浸润来缓解LN进展。这些结果表明，ATF3可能是制定LN治疗策略的潜在靶点。
